title: Luhn card number check
description: Implement luhn_valid(text). Return True if text is a valid Luhn number. Spaces and hyphens may separate digits and are ignored. Any other non-digit character makes it invalid. After stripping separators there must be at least 2 digits. Return False (never raise) for invalid string input. An all-zero string of 2+ digits is valid.
invariants: Only spaces and hyphens are ignored.
